stories.title: Arrakis Security Report Finds 76% of AI Agents Are Dormant but Keep Their Credentials and Connections
stories.description: According to the 2026 Autonomous Agents Threat Report, published by Arrakis Security, 76% of active agents have not run in 60 days, but their credentials still work and their triggers still fire. 44% have not run in 180 days.
